title: Lake Titicaca & homestay

weather.note: Your coldest night — ~0 to −1°C, no heating (blankets provided). Bright & sunny on the water; thermals + fleece after dark.

glance: Motorboat across the world's highest navigable lake to the Uros floating reed islands, then a homestay with a local family — consistently a trip highlight.
logistics: facilities basic, drop toilets, no showers

picks.name: Uros Floating Islands
picks.note: Islands hand-built from totora reeds; one of the most surreal places on the trip.

picks.name: Your homestay
picks.note: Lean in: help cook, try Quechua, join the soccer game. Bring small gifts (fruit from Puno market, school supplies).
